text.card: A red giant 3,779 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.84 solar masses and 8.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,923 K at its surface.
